remarks.text: 2 late-checked bags loaded after doors closed, pax confirmed on board.

deciding.load_reconciled: Loadsheet shows 74 bags but the hold entries sum to 72 (45+27). The weights 1009 against 1010 kg are within rounding. The bag difference of 2 is the only break, so the answer leans false.
deciding.delay_code_supported: Code BAG and last_bag 06:52 is after doors_closed 06:50, so baggage did run late. But off_blocks is 24 minutes after last_bag, which leaves doubt.
deciding.log_disposition: The remark explains the late bags that cause both the order break and the count difference. Signoff is present, so annotate and close.
deciding.offblock_delay: Off-blocks 07:16 against STD 07:00 is 16 minutes, the level 1/2 boundary.
deciding.failed_checks: Three checks look failed: bag count, last_bag after doors_closed, and off-blocks over 3 minutes late. The bag difference is only 2 with weights in tolerance, so two is also defensible.
